tool.name: read_file
tool.description: Read the contents of a file on the system

when_to_use.trigger: User asks to see file contents

parameters.param: Absolute or relative path to the file to read
Maximum number of lines to return (head/tail behavior)
Line offset to start reading from (0-indexed)

safety_rules.rule: Never read files in /etc/shadow, /etc/gshadow, or private key files
Refuse to read files containing API keys, tokens, or credentials
Warn before reading very large files (>10MB)
Check file permissions before attempting to read
Suggest head/tail for log files instead of full read

tool.output_format: Returns: { "content": string, // File contents "path": string, // Resolved absolute path "size_bytes": integer, "line_count": integer, "truncated": boolean // True if content was truncated }
